title: Halting after a return instruction
statement: Let $A$ be a register program with oracle, let $x$ be an input, and let $G$ be a predicate on configurations. If the instruction of $A$ at state $l$ is to return the Boolean value $r$, and $G$ holds of the configuration with state $l$, register values $v$, and no recorded result, then the run from that configuration halts with answer $r$ and satisfies $G$ at every configuration before halting.
